Name: Pet Harp Seal
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I got a request to make a pet seal mod. As it happens, during my hiatus, I got perms from some authors on naver to use assets to update some of their old mods, and I thought this lil guy was perfect. You can choose him as your default pet and Marnie will bring him to you, or you can adopt him later.

[s]I may or may not make him a farm animal later but for now, he's a squishy lil house guest.[/s] He's now also available as a farm animal in my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43308]Marine Livestock[/url] :)

Enjoy!
